subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Green Revolution** refers to a set of research, development, and technology transfer initiatives occurring between the 1940s and the late 1960s, which increased agricultural production worldwide, particularly in developing countries. (हरित क्रांति)

 
 
• **Example:** The **Green Revolution **led to a significant increase in food grain production, particularly in wheat and rice.
 
 
 
• In the context,** "through the implementation of the seed-water-fertiliser-led Green Revolution"** **fits well as it indicates the significant agricultural transformation that led to self-sufficiency in food grains. (बीज-पानी-उर्वरक-आधारित हरित क्रांति)**
 
 
• **Example:** The **Green Revolution** played a crucial role in making India self-sufficient in food grains by 1976.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Green Revolution**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **White Revolution** (श्वेत क्रांति): Refers to the rapid development in the dairy industry that made India one of the largest producers of milk.

 
 
• **Example:** The **White Revolution **significantly increased milk production in India.
 
 
 
• **Blue Revolution** (नीली क्रांति): Refers to the management of water resources that contributed to the rise of the aquaculture industry.
 
 
• **Example:** The **Blue Revolution **augmented the fish production in India.
 
 
 
• **Pink Revolution** (गुलाबी क्रांति): Refers to the increase in production of meat, especially poultry and pork.
 
 
• **Example:** The **Pink Revolution** focused on enhancing meat production in the country.
 
 

46:Tc03,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
